angle: DL/EDGE: Run-the-Hoop bend (Hoop G) and pass-rush-drill burst vs NFL pressure rate, get-off and rush-path bend; year-standardized; no-tracking baseline (log pick, weight, NGS athleticism, EDGE share) with 10-yd split + 3-cone as imputed variants
metric_name: Hoop G: the hardest sideways push a rusher holds for 0.5 s while rounding the hoops (g, z within Combine year), shrunk by one-run reliability 0.41
headline_number: Planning effect 0.8 extra pressures per season per sd of Hoop G after correcting for 14 screened pairs (raw 3.1), equal to moving from pick 100 to pick 76; in-sample rho 0.32 [0.06, 0.54], n=63; slope same with or without an official 40 (+0.58 vs +0.73 pp, interaction p=0.74); best-of-14 p=0.121, nested p=0.091
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_03/revised. (1) Single headline: the shrunk 0.8 pressures/season, priced in draft slots (pick 100 -> 76; raw 100 -> 37). (2) Missing-40 dependence resolved with a Hoop G x has-40 interaction (class fixed effects, class-stratified bootstrap): slopes +0.58 vs +0.73 pp, p=0.74; the 14 no-40 players described; subgroup hypothesis pre-registered. (3) Class-stratified bootstrap distribution of held-out dR2 for every baseline (share > 0 reported: 75% main, 36% among the 49 who ran the 40); angle baseline with 10-yd + 3-cone (multiple imputation) added. (4) Placebo outcomes: tackle rate and get-off (no positive link). (5) Technique/scheme: time to pressure, quick-pressure share, sacks per pressure, EDGE vs interior, snap alignment odds; blocker type stated as unavailable. (6) Availability caveat: excluded runners play a median 1 game/season vs 14; adding games/season leaves the effect at 0.32. (7) Full 2023-25 board (109 runners) in board_2023_2025.csv with intervals, weight, role, pick, rookie pressure interval, film flag and a three-line decision rule; Fig 6 shows all 42 2025 runners. (8) New Fig 5 film-check cards for Ezeiruaku and Phillips with pressure snaps highlighted. (9) Fig 3 split into a scatter (Fig 3) and a forest + held-out dR2 violins (Fig 4); Fig 2 cut to 5 metrics with n in labels; Fig 1 card headers in plain words with play counts. (10) Writeup text is rendered from writeup_template.md via numbers.json keys (one bootstrap source per number; 0.18/0.19 and 0.57/0.61 inconsistencies removed); 60-word football-first opening, why DL/why now, burst section merged into framing, pre-registered test before Limitations. 6 figures + 2 tables, 1,7xx words.
open_risks: The main result still does not clear selection (best-of-14 p=0.121, nested p=0.091); judges may read it as a null.
With 10-yd split and 3-cone imputed (the angle baseline), the effect weakens to 0.26 and its CI touches zero; the held-out gain is ~0 there.
Pre-registered 2026-27 test has power 0.13 at the planning effect; it can only rule out a large effect.
Technique tie (dip/rip) is not supported by timing or finish splits; Hoop G reads as a general change-of-direction trait.
Full script takes about 16 minutes (bootstrapped whole-loop refits and permutations).
